events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Basil Fawlty', John Cleese has given us some of the most iconic comedy moments in British history. Happy 87th to a true legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', commonly known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that is the 'White Album'. A double album like no other, showcasing their incredible range.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. A voice, a showman, a legend who continues to inspire. His music truly lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push musical boundaries and embrace a more introspective sound.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember musician, singer-songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon, who passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. A true icon.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. Forever a trailblazer, his influence on music, fashion, and art is immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King's impact on music and culture is still felt today. Thank you, thank you very much.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist, songwriter, and producer Jimmy Page, best known as the founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind and one of rock's most influential guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking and captivating audiences worldwide. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the iconic British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! The voice behind so many classic tracks that soundtracked a generation.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul Star
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the incredible Paul Young! That voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, who passed away in 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: A National Treasure
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music, heart, and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter, pianist, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That's biggest hits to his solo career, a true songwriting talent.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Still got that 'Caribbean Queen' energy. What's your favourite hit?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame 1989 Induction Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the fourth annual Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring artists like The Rolling Stones, Stevie Wonder, and Otis Redding.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty gathered for the 1989 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. A star-studded night celebrating music's greatest.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, a consistent presence in British pop.
